text:
olivia: Kairos wants a quick POC next Tue/Wed. Objectives: sustain ~1k qps at ~512-token avg, survive intermittent 10k qps spikes, and keep p95 <250ms. They also want a high-level cost cap and SOC2-compatible log segregation notes. Can we sketch a minimal test plan and call out any immediate blockers?
matt (solutions): Ill take runbook ownership. Proposed flow: (1) quick smoke, (2) controlled ramp/soak on Dedicated, (3) burst overflow to Hosted. Will include warmup hooks.
kevin (bench): A few constraints: longer responses drop qps per GPU a lot. Using our quantized 70B baseline, expect ~300-450ms p95 per request single GPU under light load. That implies ~5-7 GPUs to hit sustained 1k depending on batching and KV cache.
kevin (bench): Suggested load pattern (wrk/vegeta): steady 1k qps for 30m, then 4-6 short spikes at 8-12k for 20-60s. Add randomized interarrival for realism.
matt (solutions): Runbook (compact): prep (endpoint, creds, model-pin), warmup (5-10 realistic prompts per replica), smoke 10m@100qps, ramp 30m->1k, soak 90-120m@800-1k, burst windows (20-60s at target), observability (p50/p95/p99, GPU util, queue depth), rollback (route to Hosted and drain).
sarah (pricing): Pricing approach: reserved Dedicated sized to cover ~75% of steady tokens + PAYG Hosted credits for overflow spikes. For a POC sketch assume 6 reserved GPUs + burst credits; will produce a short estimate once Kevin posts per-GPU throughput.
nina (security): SOC2 notes: we can export redacted logs to S3/SIEM, and for Private deployments disable control-plane request body retention. BYOK/KMS available. Network: IP allowlist and PrivateLink for Dedicated. Blocker: if they require fully air-gapped on-prem deployment, timeline is multi-week and needs legal signoff.
mike (cs): Ill schedule the smoke and invite Kairos SRE. Recommend a 10m pre-check tomorrow to validate API keys, routing, and log export. Also confirm DPA signed before we ship logs.
olivia: Cold-start/tail concerns? Kairos specifically flagged p95 stability across bursts.
kevin (bench): Cold starts mostly from KV cache and lazy kernel paths. Recommend keeping a fat minimum replica count to preserve KV and a short warmup prior to smoke. Also capture token-level timing to isolate kernel vs IO stalls.
matt (solutions): Ill add autoscaler policy: min_replicas=3 (for warm KV) with aggressive scale-up on CPU/GPU queue depth. Also include a traffic-split rule that sends overflow to Hosted when queue depth > X or error rate > 0.5%.
sarah (pricing): Can we agree to present an estimate with a conservative cap and a delta for burst credits? I'll format a one-pager for the call.
kevin (bench): Ill run a quick microbench on the quant70B and post tokens/sec and p95 later today. That will refine GPUs needed.
matt (solutions): Will post a first-pass runbook + command snippets (vegeta/wrk) in ~3h. Any objections to using Hosted for overflow? Operationally simplest.
nina (security): No objections, but require SOW language re: retention, redaction, and access controls.
olivia: Great. @mike please schedule and drop calendar link here when done. Target: have runbook + price sketch by EOD so Kairos can approve timebox.
